spanish: Y sus cadáveres ustedes caerán en el desierto este.

findings.issue: The qal imperfect is 3mp and agrees with the masculine plural corpses; the independent 2mp pronoun emphasizes those possessors and is not the verb’s subject. Placing ustedes immediately before caerán makes the addressees the ones who fall.

notes: Conjunction, corpse noun, desert, and demonstrative are licensed; sus can be the ustedes possessive.
